video.title: AI欧腐《重生后，我依然选择你/Reborn to Choose You》
video.desc:
攻重生剧本 剧本算比较不一样了 整体还可以 不过我也没懂算不算完结 感觉没完结
After seven years of love and a marriage on the verge of divorce, Lucas loses Owen just as he finally realizes how badly he has failed him. But on the night before their divorce, a sudden accident sends Lucas seven years into the past—to the very first day they met on a dating reality show. Determined not to repeat the same mistakes, Lucas tries to keep his distance. Yet his body remembers Owen before his mind can stop it. He knows Owen’s allergies, old injuries, habits, fears, and even songs that haven’t been written yet. The more Lucas pushes him away, the more Owen suspects that the cold, guarded actor is hiding a love far deeper than a first meeting could explain. As jealousy, scandals, industry schemes, and secrets from another lifetime threaten to tear them apart, Lucas must learn the lesson he failed to understand before: love is not choosing someone’s future for them—it is standing beside them and letting them choose too. This time, when Owen reaches for him, Lucas refuses to stay silent.
相爱七年，婚姻却走到离婚边缘。直到失去Owen的那一刻，Lucas才终于意识到，自己曾经把他伤得有多深。
可就在两人离婚前夜，一场突如其来的意外，将Lucas送回了七年前——回到他们在恋爱真人秀上初次相遇的那一天。
这一次，Lucas决心不再重蹈覆辙，于是努力与Owen保持距离。可他的身体却比理智更早记得Owen：他知道Owen的过敏源、旧伤、习惯、恐惧，甚至知道那些此时还未被写出的歌曲。
Lucas越是推开他，Owen越是怀疑，这个冷淡又戒备的演员，心里藏着一份远远超过“初次见面”所能解释的深情。
当嫉妒、绯闻、娱乐圈的算计，以及来自上一世的秘密不断威胁着他们的关系时，Lucas终于必须明白，自己曾经没能学会的道理：爱一个人，不是替对方选择未来，而是站在对方身边，让对方也拥有选择的权利。
这一世，当Owen再次向他伸出手，Lucas不再选择沉默。
